headline: KPMG Australia Cuts Another 230 Jobs Amid Client Data Misuse Allegations
summary: KPMG Australia is cutting a further 230 roles, bringing total redundancies this year to over 600 following allegations of client data misuse.
why: Professional services firm redundancies reflect reputational fallout and contracting demand within advisory and consulting divisions.

impacts.name: KPMG Australia
impacts.why: Large-scale job cuts reflect reduced consulting revenue and restructuring following data controversies.
